title: Business lending, September quarter 2026: construction up, property purchases down
description: ABS Lending Indicators for the September quarter 2026: business construction lending up 27.6%, property purchase lending down 6.4%, and what changed for small businesses.
seo_title: Business lending September quarter 2026: ABS figures | Lambton Capital

faq.q: How much did business construction lending rise in the September quarter 2026?
faq.a: New business loan commitments for construction rose 27.6% on the June quarter to $17.2b, and 51.8% on the September quarter 2025, seasonally adjusted (ABS Lending Indicators).

faq.q: Did lending to buy commercial property fall?
faq.a: Business lending to purchase property fell 6.4% on the June quarter to $25.4b, seasonally adjusted, but was 1.5% higher than a year earlier.
